title: Dispatch: 19.4.5 faithful-or-absent effects repair from subsystem review 19.4.5.7 (attempt 4)
description: ONE comprehensive repair of PR #653 per user decision 2026-10-11 (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent) using the full inventory in subsystem review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.7 (read its notes in full; identifiers are corrected in parts 4 and 6). SCOPE BOUNDARY: every member whose path is mechanics.effects[] or variants[].mechanics.effects[] (S1.01-S1.15, S1.19 and the effect-level parts of S2/S4/S5/S6 members, e.g. c2-residual-whip-attack, m3-gem-of-seeing-truesight, c2-residual-etherealness, c2-residual-rulership-save, c2-residual-assisted-escape-save, wand-of-enemy-detection and ring-of-x-ray m3 effects, c2-residual-goat-terror-aura, c2-slay-on-critical payload/chargeCost, c2-residual-enhanced-sphere-levitation, manual/tome abilityScoreIncrease effects - extract the complete list mechanically from the notes and report it). Everything else (operations, activation, stateMachine, economies, entityGrant, containment S1.16-S1.18, spellStore, rollManipulation) belongs to eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 - do NOT change it here except where an effect removal forces a reference update. RULE per effect member, re-reading the printed text: (a) if the existing typed fields can carry the printed predicate EXACTLY (e.g. a creature-only target, ranged-only appliesTo), make it exact; (b) otherwise REMOVE the typed effect and record the clause as an executionReadiness clause with readiness 'adjudicated-by-design' whose representation carries a verbatim sourceText span (an exact substring of the item's printed description) plus a short note, so the DM model reads the printed text. Never keep a typed effect broader/narrower/differently conditioned than the source; never invent defaults. Implement the span support in the importer's readiness derivation and in kindSchemas validation (adjudicated clause sourceText must be a non-empty string; the test checks it is a verbatim substring of the record's description). Check every runtime consumer of removed effect ids (toolUseItem, itemState, itemExecutionReadiness, operation effect references, discovery) and keep use_item behaviour for green operations unchanged; if an effect removal would break an executable operation, make the effect exact instead and report it. Evidence: extend magicItemEffectSourceAgreement.test.ts with (1) the verbatim-span invariant over every adjudicated clause, (2) a generalized check that no typed effect for the reported members carries a predicate the source does not print - representative eligible/ineligible scenarios per S1 root cause, not per-item reproducers; keep all prior source-backed assertions. Regenerate pack (npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1) and inventory (npx tsx packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts); npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack; update registry row magic-item-effects statusReasoning to the bounded effects scope, the faithful-or-absent rule, and name eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 as owner of the non-effect members. Importer protocol. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes: member table (member, path, decision exact/absent, source phrase); close this bead. No push/PR.
